one_page_notes.ralphgarzajr: 2022 MLB (TB): sinker-led mix (SI ~33%, SL ~23%, CH ~19%, FF ~12%, CT ~10%). SNK upper 80s with arm-side run; SL mid/upper 70s with sweep; CH mirrors SNK run. To RHH leans SNK/SL; to LHH more CH/FF/CT. Reliever — 35.0 IP, 3.34 ERA in 2022.
